title: Changed facts proposed as edits
acceptance: A contradicting or changed fact becomes an edit shown old → new; EN and IT; tests for same, changed, new through the scheduler
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Added memory.edit with old → new approval cards and EN/IT scheduler tests for same, changed, and new in 0.25 h agent.
